title: Hearty Flaky Croatian Pastry Pilaf
description: A rich and savory Croatian dish featuring flaky pastry and a flavorful pilaf, perfect for a special occasion, this recipe is low in glycemic index and features a flambe technique for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat and cook the chicken until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, chicken broth, paprika, salt, and pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
To flambe the pilaf, add 1 tablespoon of brandy to the skillet and ignite the mixture, cooking for 1 minute.
Spoon the pilaf mixture onto one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pastry for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
